hunks.baseline: It was a fierce battle in which no one paid any heed to their own life. The victor and loser were decided just as quickly.

hunks.sol: The black wave of men dressed in black swallowed the wave of green.

hunks.sol: The Western Heaven Demon Lord, watching it all from more than a thousand feet away, spoke.

hunks.sol: “Everything according to the will of the Lord of Heaven.”

hunks.sol: What caught the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s interest were the wounds carved into the old man’s body.

hunks.sol: There were tracks leading down, but none coming back up.

hunks.sol: A solid stone wall stretching down from the ceiling blocked his path.

hunks.baseline: “Well, well. They certainly made this place complicated.”

hunks.baseline: The answer was an ear-splitting sound slicing through the air.
hunks.sol: His only answer was a piercing shriek through the air.

hunks.baseline: As the dust cloud split apart, the Western Heaven Demon Lord caught the dagger flying toward his throat and smiled faintly.
hunks.sol: The dust cloud split apart. The Western Heaven Demon Lord plucked the dagger flying toward his throat from the air and smiled.

hunks.baseline: A tall young man emerged through the dust cloud and stared at the Western Heaven Demon Lord with an impassive gaze.
hunks.sol: A tall young man emerged from the cloud of dust and stared at the Western Heaven Demon Lord with an impassive gaze.

hunks.baseline: Half of any fight was decided by aura. Just because my opponent looked weaker than me, I could not afford to lower my guard. And just because he looked stronger, I could not let myself be intimidated.
hunks.sol: Half of any fight was momentum. You couldn’t let your guard down because your opponent looked weaker, and you couldn’t let yourself be intimidated because he looked stronger.

hunks.baseline: Especially when I had come face-to-face with a genuine powerhouse like this.
hunks.sol: Especially when you were facing the real deal.

hunks.baseline: *What kind of monster is he?*
hunks.sol: *What kind of monster is this guy?*

hunks.baseline: I looked at the middle-aged man before me, inwardly clicking my tongue.
hunks.sol: I stared at the middle-aged man before me, inwardly clicking my tongue.

hunks.baseline: If Moses had parted the sea with his staff, this man had created another path through the underground prison with a single punch.
hunks.sol: If Moses had parted the sea with his staff, this man had carved a new path through the underground prison with a single punch.

hunks.baseline: That was not all. He stood there with a faint smile on his face, the very picture of tranquility.
hunks.sol: And that wasn’t all. He stood there with a faint smile, the very picture of tranquility.

hunks.baseline: *Even the air around him smells different.*
hunks.sol: *Even the air around him feels different.*

hunks.baseline: The Blood Lord had been an openly insane bastard. This middle-aged man, however, was dangerous simply by existing.
hunks.sol: The Blood Lord had been openly insane. This middle-aged man, on the other hand, was dangerous simply by existing.

hunks.baseline: Their martial arts might have been comparable in strength, but they were completely different in nature.
hunks.sol: Their martial arts might have been comparable in strength, but they were completely different kinds of monster.

hunks.baseline: I answered while lowering the spearhead of White Flame at an angle.
hunks.sol: I lowered White Flame’s spearhead at an angle.

hunks.baseline: “I’m pretty entertaining myself.”
hunks.sol: “I do have a reputation for being entertaining.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve also heard that you’re ill-mannered.”
hunks.sol: “I also heard you lack manners.”

hunks.baseline: “Well, I would have to spend more time with you to know for sure. But according to what an acquaintance told me, that seems to be the case.”
hunks.sol: “Well, I would have to spend more time with you to know for certain. But according to an acquaintance of mine, it’s true.”

hunks.baseline: “You don’t look like you have any friends. Who’s this acquaintance?”
hunks.sol: “You don’t look like you have any friends. Who’s the acquaintance?”

hunks.baseline: The smile at the corner of the middle-aged man’s mouth deepened.
hunks.sol: The smile on the middle-aged man’s lips deepened.

hunks.baseline: “He says he wants to see you very much.”
hunks.sol: “He’s very eager to see you.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t even want to look at that son of a bitch.”
hunks.sol: “I never want to see that fucking bastard again.”

hunks.baseline: “You use exactly the same words as that young man, Cheongpung. Your tone is different, though.”
hunks.sol: “That young man Cheongpung said the same thing. In a different tone, of course.”

hunks.baseline: I felt the muscles in my face stiffen before I could stop them.
hunks.sol: I felt my face stiffen despite myself.

hunks.baseline: “You, by any chance…”
hunks.sol: “You didn’t…”

hunks.baseline: The middle-aged man smiled and waved his hand.
hunks.sol: The middle-aged man smiled and waved a hand.

hunks.sol: “There’s no need to worry. I won’t kill him. I intend to take you, Cheongpung, and the Fire King back alive.”

hunks.baseline: I asked with a dumbfounded expression.

hunks.baseline: “Take us?”
hunks.sol: “Take us back?”

hunks.sol: The other fifty percent was the chance I’d end up as grilled tripe.

hunks.sol: A man who could call the Blood Lord, presumably one of Dark Heaven’s highest-ranking figures, an acquaintance. A man who could unleash that much destructive power with a single punch.

hunks.baseline: “Pleasure my ass.”
hunks.sol: Pleasure, my ass.

hunks.sol: I stared at the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s two perfectly intact arms.

hunks.sol: “I had another attached. It wasn’t originally mine, so it still doesn’t move quite as well as I’d like. If you intend to try something, aim for my left arm.”

hunks.baseline: In that slowed instant, his widening pupils reflected my figure rushing right up to him.

hunks.sol: His Benefactor in name, his friend in truth—and now, his one and only true rival.

hunks.baseline: A gentle smile formed at the corner of his mouth.
hunks.sol: A gentle smile touched Cheongpung’s lips.

hunks.baseline: “I know. I know my Benefactor thinks the same way I do.”
hunks.sol: “I know. My Benefactor feels the same way I do.”

hunks.baseline: Flames rose in the First Fiend’s eyes as he watched this.
hunks.sol: Flames blazed in the First Fiend’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: The young brat who would have died long ago if not for the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s orders had dared to ignore him. His fate was as good as sealed.
hunks.sol: This greenhorn would have died long ago if not for the Western Heaven Demon Lord’s orders, yet he dared to ignore him. That alone had sealed his fate.

hunks.baseline: The First Fiend raised his double axes, their blades caked with someone’s flesh.
hunks.sol: The First Fiend raised his twin axes, their blades caked with scraps of human flesh.

hunks.baseline: And then, at the sight of what happened before his eyes, he froze like a stone statue.
hunks.sol: Then he saw what was happening before him and froze like a statue.

hunks.baseline: The wind was blowing.
hunks.sol: A wind was blowing.

hunks.baseline: A scarlet wind of qi flowed from one person’s body, slid down his wrist, and passed onto his sword.
hunks.sol: A scarlet wind of qi flowed from Cheongpung’s body, slid down his wrist, and streamed into his sword.

hunks.baseline: It traveled past the plum blossom engraved on the hilt, wrapped around the blade, and finally bloomed into a single red plum blossom.
hunks.sol: It passed over the plum blossom engraved upon the hilt, coiled around the blade, and finally bloomed into a single crimson plum blossom.

hunks.baseline: It was a halo of light more brilliant and destructive than anything else.
hunks.sol: A halo of light, more brilliant and destructive than anything else.

hunks.baseline: A dazed voice escaped between the First Fiend’s lips as he stared at the unbelievable sight.
hunks.sol: A stunned whisper escaped the First Fiend’s lips as he stared at the impossible sight.

hunks.baseline: “...Sword Force.”
hunks.sol: “…Sword Force.”

hunks.baseline: The product of great martial artists. Proof that its wielder had reached the exalted realm known as Supreme Peak.
hunks.sol: The creation of the greatest martial artists. Proof that its wielder had reached the exalted realm of Supreme Peak.

hunks.baseline: Yet the twenty-three-year-old young man’s face wore an innocent smile wholly unsuited to a great martial artist.
hunks.sol: Yet the twenty-three-year-old young man wore an innocent smile utterly unlike that of some exalted master.
